description: Material paint after massimo-v4: the paint roles (shade and lit at an alpha) and the glass faces that the relief classes in nowind.css read. A material never changes a length or a fill of the surface ladder: it adds light (face shading, bevel, cast, inner shadow), a 1px line in place of fills, or transmission on what floats.

paint.rule: Light scheme: shade is rgb(27 28 32), lit is white, each at the role's alpha. Dark scheme: black at 3× the shade alpha and white at ¼ the lit alpha, unless the role names its own dark alpha.

glass.rule: The neutral fill (slate) at 56.00000000000001% (frosted) or 18% (clear): step 1 in light, step 3 in dark, so the glass sits lighter than the page.
glass.lens: The lens class refracts the backdrop of a glass part through an SVG displacement filter: site/site.js draws a map per element at its size and corner radius (a rounded-edge bend along the rim, a slight overall magnification, an R/G/B fringe) and sets data-lens="on" on the root in Chromium, the only engine that applies an SVG filter in backdrop-filter. Elsewhere glass keeps its blur. A page outside this site supplies the filter itself.
notDone: Massimo's glass band (a contrast and brightness filter per scheme that presses the backdrop into a readable band) and the frost texture are not ported.

materials.flat: No paint: the default. Overlays still cast.
materials.physical: Lit: face shading, a bevel (lit top, shaded bottom, half-pixel ring) and the raised cast; pressed sinks to a recess; fields and wells are recessed; cards cast at the popup level.
materials.frosted: Lit, and raised parts, cards and overlays are frosted glass: a 56% face over an 8px blur, a specular sheen, a lit rim and the cast.
materials.glass: Lit, and raised parts, cards and overlays are clear glass after Apple's Liquid Glass: an 18% face over a 0.5px blur, no gloss band, and the light catching the rim as two thin crescents on opposite corners. Add lens for refraction.
materials.outline: No fills but state: every part draws one 1px line in the muted text color; overlays stay opaque.

usage: Set a material on a region with material-physical, material-frosted, material-glass or material-outline (material-flat resets it). Parts say what they are with relief-raised (buttons), relief-raised-solid (primary buttons), relief-recessed (tracks, wells), relief-field (inputs), relief-etched, relief-ground (cards) and relief-overlay (popovers, dialogs). The nearest material wins: the classes are @scope rules that stop at a nested material.
